ModMetaData.name: StK Colored Darklights
ModMetaData.author: stk
ModMetaData.description:
Most over-saturated colors are now considered Darklight.
As long as the color's saturation is equal to or higher than 85, that color will be considered darklight by the game logic.
Does not include really warm orange/yellowish colors. Vanilla blue darklight stays at the same saturation level as before (>50).
